n1.text:
1 · Three doors, by what each needs

+ Look is in row A, on every tab: a Look lands whole and needs no selection.
FX is in row C with the selection's verbs: it starts one Local FX over the selected heads.
Palettes are in Set: its popup already draws the family's palettes above the value editor and the family's FX below it.

The Stack and FX tables keep their own + buttons.

n2.text:
2 · The palette strip goes

Set does its job: the palettes that fit the selection's family, the lit ring, a tap to press, ⌥-click as values. Set now works on whole heads too — with no cells picked it asks which attribute first — so a rows-only selection loses nothing.

New palette moves to Record ▾; Set's footer keeps Save as palette… for the cells' own values.

n3.text:
3 · ⌘K learns the programmer

On this page two groups lead: Programmer (Add a Look, Include, every Record destination, Update, Revert, Clear, Blind, fade, table, scope) and Selection (Set, Apply a palette, Add FX, Fan, Release, Narrow, the mask, Locate, Highlight, follow desk, Deselect).

Each item says what it acts on — '6 heads · Colour', 'over 1s'. The ⌘K board is clickable.

n4.text:
4 · Row C in three clusters

WHICH heads: the heads chip (count, desk link, Narrow menu, ×), then the mask.
WHAT to do to them: Set ⏎ · Fan · FX · Release ⌫ ▾.
WHERE they are on the rig: Locate ▾ · Highlight, pushed right.

Cell Clear and Release are one Release with two arms, so Clear only ever means the whole programmer.

n7.text:
FX from Values, and the FX editor

FX opens the picker on the grid, on the mask's family. If those heads already run a Local FX of that family it asks Replace · Stack — the same segment, and the same family starting blend, as + FX on an FX editor lane, lifted into one shared piece. A tap starts it; another swaps it.

Once started the popover is the live editor, with Open in FX editor ⤢: the FX tab's Selection view, these heads (it reads the same window selection), this FX picked, the graph drawing it. Starting is a busk gesture and stays on the grid; shaping is the editor's.

Focused Look layer: absorbed into the Look, no Replace · Stack. Output: disabled. Set's + FX… opens the same picker.

n5.text:
Breakpoints, by the row's own width (container queries, as today)

≥ 1100 — every word; ⏎ / ⌫ on Set and Release; Locate and Highlight worded.
800 – 1099 — Clear, Blind, Include, Locate and Highlight drop to icons; Look, Record, Set, Fan, FX and Release keep their words. The mask keeps its word.
600 – 799 — everything iconic, the mask abbreviated (Col), the filter still a field. Fade keeps its chevron.
< 600 — Look and Include merge into one + that opens a bottom sheet with Include at its top; the fade drops its chevron (as today); the heads chip counts cells only and loses its × (Deselect is in its menu); the mask is an icon; Locate and Highlight move into the heads chip's menu; Set, FX and Release ▾ open bottom sheets. Row A stays 247px of verbs, as today; row C is 350 of 366.
Short (≤ 500px tall) — rows A and B fold onto one line as today; row C is out of the flow until something is selected.

Nothing in row A goes behind a kebab at any width.

t5.text: ⌘K, and the bar as it is today

n6.text: Today: the strip takes the middle of row C, the verbs are seven peers (Set · Clear · Fan · Release · Locate ▾ · Highlight · Deselect) after it, the desk chip sits mid-row between the hints and the strip, and Clear appears twice with two meanings. Palettes, Looks and FX can only be added from the Stack and FX tabs.
